name: TCB Companies Inc.
old_description: TCB Companies brings more than 40 years of industry experience to our partnerships. Featuring a one-of-a-kind seamless manufacturing system, and designed around a “can do” mentality,
about:
TCB Companies Inc. operates from its headquarters in Perry, Iowa, with a second production site in Vietnam that allows near-continuous manufacturing. The business traces its roots back more than 40 years, though a specific founding year and the names of its founders have not been publicly disclosed. Ownership structure is also not detailed in available sources.

The company provides custom product solutions for distributors and corporate clients, specializing in private-label garment manufacturing and fulfillment services. Its capabilities span laser cutting, bundle and kit assembly, and the production of a broad range of apparel and promotional items including polos, hats, jerseys, jackets, coolers, and safety gear. TCB describes its operation as a seamless manufacturing system that controls each phase from design through delivery.

Primary customers are distributors seeking private-label programs and corporate buyers needing branded merchandise. Concrete examples from the company’s catalog include unlined Spartan shorts, rubber snapback caps, ultra-light polos, bucket hats, bomber jackets, and straw hats. The firm also serves the safety-equipment segment with dedicated product lines.

TCB emphasizes its international structure as a key differentiator, stating that it enables control over every production phase and supports a 'can do' mentality. The company cites ingenuity, integrity, and high-quality customer service as the foundations of its approach, aiming to deliver an experience that traditional suppliers cannot match.
